slots.metaDescription: Order a hand-drawn custom pokemon portrait from your photo. Preview within 72 hours, unlimited free revisions, and digital or print options.
slots.heroHeading: Become the Trainer You Always Were
slots.description: ["Turn your favourite photo into a bright, adventure-ready custom pokemon portrait, hand-drawn by a human artist at Anime Cabinet. Our artists capture the details that make you recognisable—your hairstyle, glasses, freckles, smile, and personal expression—then reimagine you as an original anime-inspired trainer. Choose a confident pose, a cheerful companion pet, a favourite type-inspired colour palette, or a route-like background to give the artwork its own story. The result is fan-art inspired rather than a copied official character: you become an original trainer in a familiar visual language, without impersonating a copyrighted character.","Wondering, ‘draw me as a pokemon trainer’? Upload a clear photo and add your ideas in the order notes. Waist-up and full-body photos both work well, while separate pet photos help our artists preserve your companion’s markings and personality. You can request a solo trainer, couple, family, best-friend duo, or birthday portrait, with details such as fire, water, or grass-inspired colours. Every commission includes a preview within 72 hours and unlimited free revisions, so you can request adjustments until the composition feels right. This makes a personalised pokemon gift for birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, new adventures, or the fan who has never stopped choosing their starter.","Your pokemon custom portrait can be delivered as a digital artwork for sharing, gifting, or printing, with print-ready options available when offered at checkout. Pricing starts at $39.99, with the final cost depending on the number of people, pets, format, and artwork choices. To commission your portrait, select your preferred options, upload your reference photo, describe the trainer mood and background you want, and place your order. A human artist then develops the illustration and sends your preview. If you are comparing styles, explore our [Ghibli-inspired portraits](/portraits/ghibli-style), or read our guide to a [Pokemon-inspired custom poster](/blog/pokemon-inspired-custom-poster) for display ideas. For more gift inspiration, see our [best gifts for Pokemon fans](/blog/best-gifts-for-pokemon-fans). Anime Cabinet offers 24 anime and cartoon styles, so you can also browse the [full portrait collection](/)."]
